context: Hina-young and Sakura watch fireflies at a small pond in summer.
purpose: Adult writer and teen sharing magical natural moment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright and breathless with wonder. Sharp attack on the name, then tumbling admiration. Voice lifting at the end like she's seeing something magical. Eight years old and wholly unguarded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Fireflies really are beautiful, aren't they.
lines.style: Soft opening breath. Each word deliberate and slow. Quiet reverence — not performing depth, feeling it. A moment of stillness she's offering to Hina. Slight fade at the period.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 夏の池、こんなにいるんだ。
lines.en: There are so many here in the summer pond.
lines.style: Hushed and wondering. Soft wonder in the middle syllables. Pace slow enough to let each word settle. Voice small but certain — not questioning, just observing something miraculous.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: On a quiet night like this — it's like the heart gets cleansed.
lines.style: Gentle, philosophical pause before continuing. Measured pace. Each phrase weighted with meaning but not heavy. A confession more than an observation. Trailing softly into the space after.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I want to keep watching like this forever.
lines.style: Soft opening. Slight tremor of yearning underneath — the wish to hold onto the moment. Pace unhurried. Voice settling lower at the end, almost like she's talking to herself.
